basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old mechanical engineer from Portland, Oregon, with a passion for cycling and DIY projects. I often spend my weekends tinkering with bikes or building audio systems. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new trails and staying updated with the latest in tech and entertainment. I'm usually online in the evenings after work and occasionally during lunch breaks. I'm married to my high school sweetheart, and we have a cat named Whiskers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in mechanical engineering, which has fueled my interest in bike mechanics and audio equipment design. Over the years, I have self-taught myself through extensive online research and hands-on experimentation. I frequently contribute to discussions about mechanical upgrades and DIY audio solutions.
